package.name: umiusi_rl_control
package.description: UMIUSI low-level control layer: a self-contained RL attitude(-velocity) controller (rl_attitude_node) と keyboard teleop。武装/解除 (e-stop) と IMU サニティは層をまたぐので umiusi_common が持つ。Builds INDEPENDENTLY of the perception / autonomy stack — it does NOT depend on umiusi_perception; the RL policy needs only torch + numpy (pip) at runtime (no SB3/gymnasium). Consumes an umiusi_rl_control_msgs/AttitudeTarget setpoint and drives the sinsei_umiusi_control direct-override thrusters.
